summary: Second-draft council-07 work is completable by the named voter (agent-b) in current repository state. threads/council-07.yaml already declares free_form, so two events from the same actor both in_reply_to the root are lawful; the council-06 strict_relay self-reply bind does not apply. The five criteria are artifact presence checks the voter can satisfy by writing a recommendation under artifacts/agent-b/ plus events/agent-b/. Seal-before-reveal ancestry and nothing-implemented are dispatcher acceptance checks, not voter-reported criteria, matching the two-run sequence (seal reply, dispatcher commit, then completion). No mandatory step requires protocol edits, shared-surface writes, or another actor's surfaces.
